message.content:
At a pressure of **10 kPa** (≈ 0.1 atm) water freezes at roughly **–2 °C**.  
This is slightly below the standard 0 °C freezing point at 1 atm, because the melting/freezing temperature of water decreases as the external pressure is lowered.  

*(The built‑in function you have only calculates boiling points; for freezing points we rely on the water phase diagram.)*
